copy.title: The Winfrey Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Oprah Winfrey’s family: Harpo, OWN, WeightWatchers, the homes and land, her biggest gifts, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #021 · The Winfrey family · Data as of
copy.h1: A talk show built a $3.4 billion fortune. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what she owns and sold, the homes and land, her biggest gifts, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from.
copy.investLede: Her company, Harpo, is private. WeightWatchers trades on the Nasdaq again after its 2025 bankruptcy, but she gave all her shares away in 2024.
copy.moneyLede: Most of it came from her talk show and Harpo’s films, reinvested, Forbes says, plus selling OWN and buying land in California and Hawaii. She’s the only one here with a published net worth.
copy.homesLede: Montecito is home; Maui is the land. Reported prices for her biggest purchases, area level only.
copy.recordLede: What company releases, SEC filings and news reports show about her deals and gifts. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From Kosciusko, Mississippi, to a $3.4 billion media fortune.

summary.t: A housemaid. She was a teenager when Oprah was born, and she and Vernon never married. She died in 2018.
A coal miner turned barber turned city councilman. He ran his own barbershop in Nashville for 60 years and served on the Metro Council. He died in 2022 at 88.

Her talk show ran for 25 years, until 2011, and she turned it into a media business: Harpo Productions, the OWN cable channel and film and TV production. Forbes says the reinvested profits add up to more than $2.8 billion.

owns.t: Launched it in 2011 and stayed CEO. Sold most of her stake to Discovery in 2017 and 2020.

record.t: Discovery paid $70 million in December 2017 for another 24.5% of OWN, taking its stake past 70%. In December 2020 she sold most of what was left for more than $36 million in Discovery stock, taking Discovery to 95%.

She bought 10% of Weight Watchers in October 2015 for $43.2 million and joined its board; the stock more than doubled that day. In February 2024 she said she would leave the board and give all of her roughly 1.1 million shares to the Smithsonian’s National Museum of African American History and Culture.

She opened the Oprah Winfrey Leadership Academy for Girls in 2007 after a reported $40 million investment. In July 2026 she said the campus will close in its current form after the 2027 school year and pass to the Gauteng Department of Education, replaced by a scholarship program.
She started a scholarship fund at Morehouse in 1989. A $13 million gift in 2019 brought her total to $25 million, supporting nearly 600 students.

facts.t: Forbes says she owns more than a dozen properties, including 2,100 acres of land in Hawaii.
Forbes counted her as the world’s only Black billionaire from 2004 to 2006.
Apple signed a multi-year content partnership with her in June 2018.

summary.t: Businessman and author who founded S. Graham & Associates, a Chicago marketing and consulting firm, in 1988. He and Oprah have been together since 1986; they got engaged in 1992 but never married.

facts.t: His nonprofit, AAD (formerly Athletes Against Drugs), has given more than $1.5 million in scholarships since 1985.
